notes: Full backup keeps the whole car again: the SVT read from the car is saved in the backup, the fault memory is read through E-Sys's own connection when the gateway lets only one program in, and an older SVT is never saved under the connected car's VIN. Changed files say so: E-Sys's own Save, Ctrl+S and Save As in the SVT editor and FDL-Editor write a copy with MODIFIED in its name and never overwrite the file read from the car. Module lines in the SVT show their description also when the car has newer software than your PSdZData. The Flash assistant checks before flashing that your PSdZData has every flash file the job needs. Writing the vehicle order checks the order E-Sys will really write and says no before anything is changed when the car or E-Sys is not ready. FSC status reads in remote sessions, the battery and ignition plates keep reading after you connect the same car again, and Code several says what to do when a car's coding was not read yet. E-Sys left hanging without any window: pressing play asks whether to end it and start again. Updating is quicker: Windows asks for permission right after E-Sys MAX closes, without a long black screen first.
